instruction: Adjust VS Code settings to show animated GIF backgrounds beneath the code editing area.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not natively support animated GIF backgrounds in the editor. While extensions might provide custom backgrounds, the base VS Code application has no built-in feature for setting animated backgrounds behind code, making this task impossible to complete through standard UI interaction.
